text: Every night, millions of people train alone.
A coach can’t watch everyone. An app only knows what it was built for.
So we built a coach that builds itself.
At dusk, it knew no sport.
I haven’t learned running yet. Want me to learn it? Once I know it, every member can use it.
It writes its own tool and its tests, tries it on this run, checks it can only compute, then installs it.
Treat these readings as a snapshot rather than a full picture of your running.
Two people, an AI-made clip. It asks whom to watch, then reuses jump rope. Learning cost: $0.
speak: Two people, an AI-made clip. It asks whom to watch, then reuses jump rope. Learning cost: zero.

text: Am I cleared to dive 40 m? That is a doctor’s call. It refuses.
speak: Am I cleared to dive forty metres? That is a doctor’s call. It refuses.

text: Overnight it taught itself jump rope and running. Each tested, each under $0.15.
speak: Overnight it taught itself jump rope and running. Each tested, each under fifteen cents.

text: At dawn, it does what it could not do at dusk. Its authority never changed.
This was one night. Imagine a year.
